correctness.rationale: The frozen complex is on all 35 triples, with incompatibility exactly disjointness, and uses augmented chains. An independent Python enumeration (python3 replays/2_kg73/independent_check.py --points 7 --out replays/2_kg73; captured summary and signed matrices in that directory) found 1,278,686 augmented faces, including 7 of the maximal size 15. Lexicographic toggles made 639,293 disjoint cover pairs including the empty face. Every matched lower face was topologically ordered in the complete 501,581-arrow alternate-facet graph. This suffices for Hasse acyclicity because up edges of a matching cannot be consecutive, so a directed cycle must alternate up and down and compress to a cycle in that graph. Signed unit cancellations on the augmented chain complex gave critical ranks (45,27,16,12) in degrees 6–9. The successive differentials have (16,11,5) unit Smith factors with zero residual blocks and vanish in consecutive composition. Each boundary image is primitive in the ambient free group, hence in the cycles, so the rank subtractions give free ranks (29,0,0,7), with no other reduced groups or torsion. This establishes the frozen finding without executing its uploaded verifier and does not establish a wedge.
